enabled.label: Make an account with the first order
enabled.help: On: the phone number a customer orders with becomes his account, so his orders, deliveries and size exchanges wait for him in My account. The account never gets a password: he signs in with a one-time SMS code to that number, and may set a password afterwards. Off: a guest's order stays without an account.

enabled.label: "Your account is ready" on the thank-you page
enabled.help: Shows the customer the number he signs in with and that the sign-in code comes by SMS, with a button to My account. Never a password.

limits.label: Sign-in code: length, time and limits
limits.help: How many digits the one-time SMS code has, how many minutes it works, how many wrong tries it allows, how long before a new code may be asked for, and how many codes one number and one internet address may ask for in an hour. The limits stop someone guessing codes or filling a customer's phone with SMS.

text.label: The sign-in code SMS
text.help: The words of the SMS with the code, in English and Bengali (sent in the language the customer uses). {code} is the code, {store} the shop's name, {minutes} how long it works. Keep it short: a Bengali SMS costs more per part.

login.label: Sign-in with a password
login.help: Password: a customer who has set his own password in My account may sign in with it (accounts made with an order have none; they sign in by SMS code). New-device code: a password sign-in on a phone or computer not seen before also asks for the SMS code. Device days: how long a device stays known after a code sign-in.

tabs.label: My account sections
tabs.help: Which sections My account shows, in this order: orders, for you (offers), rewards, wallet, wishlist, profile. My orders always shows. On a phone they are the row of chips, on a computer the side menu.

max.label: Saved delivery addresses
max.help: How many delivery addresses a customer may keep in his profile (home, office …). The first is the default.

lists.label: Lists in My account
lists.help: How many orders My orders lists, how many wallet entries the wallet shows, and how many new products the "New in" row on For you shows (0 hides the row).

offerBanner.label: Offer banner in My account
offerBanner.help: Off by default. When on, the top of My orders shows the customer's real wallet balance (only when there is credit) and your member offers, each with your own title and note in both languages. An offer with a coupon code shows only while that coupon works for this customer (switched on, inside its dates, not for guests only, not used up). With nothing to show, there is no banner.

photo.label: Profile photo
photo.help: Off by default. When on, Profile lets a customer pick a photo for his account picture. It is cropped square and shrunk on his own phone and kept only in that browser: nothing is uploaded or stored by the shop. The largest file he may pick, and the size it is shrunk to.
